changes.reason: Reuse the established CrownThrive GitHub quota-shield pattern for the read-only collision observer: authenticated provider reads remain first, but a 403/429 may degrade to the exact same public GitHub GET only after that exact resource succeeds publicly. Public mode is hard-bounded to 50 requests, emits transport evidence, never writes, and remains fail-closed if provider truth cannot be established through either transport.

Add deterministic adversarial coverage for authenticated 403 public degradation, public fallback failure, hard request-budget enforcement, transport evidence, and preservation of fail-closed/no-authority-expansion invariants.
